signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAHQR( WANTT, WANTZ, N, ILO, IHI, H, LDH, W, ILOZ,

params.name: wantt
params.reference: = .TRUE. : the full Schur form T is required; = .FALSE.: only eigenvalues are required.

params.name: wantz
params.reference: = .TRUE. : the matrix of Schur vectors Z is required; = .FALSE.: Schur vectors are not required.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix H. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: It is assumed that H is already upper triangular in rows and columns `IHI`+1:N, and that $H(\mathrm{ILO},\mathrm{ILO}-1) = 0$ (unless `ILO = 1`). ZLAHQR works primarily with the Hessenberg submatrix in rows and columns `ILO` to `IHI`, but applies transformations to all of H if `WANTT` is .TRUE.. $1 \le \mathrm{ILO} \le \max (1,\mathrm{IHI})$; $\mathrm{IHI} \le N$.

params.name: H
params.reference: On entry, the upper Hessenberg matrix H. On exit, if `INFO` is zero and if `WANTT` is .TRUE., then H is upper triangular in rows and columns `ILO`:`IHI`. If `INFO` is zero and if `WANTT` is .FALSE., then the contents of H are unspecified on exit. The output state of H in case INF is positive is below under the description of `INFO`.

params.name: ldh
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array H. $\mathrm{LDH} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: w
params.reference: The computed eigenvalues `ILO` to `IHI` are stored in the corresponding elements of W. If `WANTT` is .TRUE., the eigenvalues are stored in the same order as on the diagonal of the Schur form returned in H, with $W(i) = H(i,i)$.

params.name: ihiz
params.reference: Specify the rows of Z to which transformations must be applied if `WANTZ` is .TRUE.. $1 \le \mathrm{ILOZ} \le \mathrm{ILO}$; $\mathrm{IHI} \le \mathrm{IHIZ} \le N$.

params.name: Z
params.reference: If `WANTZ` is .TRUE., on entry Z must contain the current matrix Z of transformations accumulated by CHSEQR, and on exit Z has been updated; transformations are applied only to the submatrix `Z(ILOZ:IHIZ,ILO:IHI)`. If `WANTZ` is .FALSE., Z is not referenced.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, ZLAHQR failed to compute all the eigenvalues `ILO` to `IHI` in a total of 30 iterations per eigenvalue; elements i+1:ihi of W contain those eigenvalues which have been successfully computed.

If $\mathrm{INFO} > 0$ and `WANTT` is .FALSE., then on exit, the remaining unconverged eigenvalues are the eigenvalues of the upper Hessenberg matrix rows and columns `ILO` through `INFO` of the final, output value of H.

```text
        If INFO > 0 and WANTT is .TRUE., then on exit
(*)       (initial value of H)*U  = U*(final value of H)
        where U is an orthogonal matrix.    The final
        value of H is upper Hessenberg and triangular in
        rows and columns INFO+1 through IHI.
```

If $\mathrm{INFO} > 0$ and `WANTZ` is .TRUE., then on exit

(final value of Z) = (initial value of Z)\*U

where U is the orthogonal matrix in (\*) (regardless of the value of `WANTT`.)
